chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Lu sings She's Just Been a Good Woman
summary: Danny asks Lu to sing a song and she performs the blues ballad of a woman who shoots her cheating man; Milt thanks her.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: And Danny, you said you would have Lu sing one thing.
I think you should have one of what you done. "She's Just Been A Good Woman."

"I...I...I... been a good woman,/Everybody knows/I been a good woman,/Everybody knows/That I paid three hundred dollars/To buy my man a suit of clothes./I went to see my daddy./I didn't mean no harm./I went to see my daddy, I didn't mean no harm./But when I peeped through the keyhole/I saw my man in another woman's arms./I called my daddy,/And he started to run./I called my daddy/And he started to run./But when I seen him running,/I shot him with his own gun./Now, I'm laying in the jail/With my back turned to the wall./I'm layin' in the jail/With my back turned to the wall./I'm writing a letter to the boy and girl/My great man was the cause of it all."
